title: Handling Credit on Multi-Unit Replacement Lines — Cartwise Grocery Orders Store Operations Standard
content:
# Handling credit for multi-unit replacements

Store operations standard for Cartwise Grocery Orders, on replacement lines that attract a price-protection refund.

## Standard

The price-protection handling credit is added to the price-protection refund after the refund is rounded to the cent:

- when at least 2 replacement units were billed and the replacement is perishable, the credit is 0.50 per billed unit;
- when at least 2 replacement units were billed and the replacement is not perishable, the credit is 0.25 per billed unit;
- otherwise there is none.

The refund with the credit never exceeds the line's billed charge.

## Facts used

Both facts come from the replacement line's billed entry: the billed quantity (units billed) and the item class of the product handed over, perishable or another class.

## Credit table (hypothetical lines)

| Replacement billed units | Replacement item class | Handling credit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | perishable | none |
| 2 | perishable | 1.00 (2 units at 0.50) |
| 3 | perishable | 1.50 (3 units at 0.50) |
| 2 | pantry | 0.50 (2 units at 0.25) |
| 4 | household | 1.00 (4 units at 0.25) |
| 1 | pantry | none |
